recommendations.recommendation: Local non-synced SQLite journal; DELETE rollback journal, synchronous EXTRA, explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE and unique reservation/command constraints; fail closed on contention/uncertain commit; no automatic retries.
recommendations.rationale: Small single-host metadata journal needs transactional consumption, not high write throughput; local rollback mode minimizes moving parts.
alternatives: WAL with FULL and patched version if demonstrated concurrency requires it
Remote transactional database only if a genuinely multi-host design is adopted
limits: No SQLite database/version/filesystem capability measured or created
Process-crash tests do not establish actual power-loss durability
Backups must be coherent and restored state cannot reopen consumed attempts; externally sealed high-watermark reconciliation required

recommendations.recommendation: Local Windows named pipe with explicit least-privilege descriptor, remote clients rejected, bounded overlapped I/O and peer PID/creation/registration checks; role-separated per-scope HMAC-SHA256 authentication over validated RFC8785 canonical messages; DPAPI-protected local secrets and explicit revocation.
recommendations.rationale: Keep the control path local and independent of the ordinary HTTP request wait while authenticating exact-bound intents and receipts.
alternatives: Mutual TLS with approved certificate lifecycle if remote control is later required
Asymmetric issuer signatures if independent attribution/non-repudiation is required
limits: No key, canonicalizer, pipe or ACL created; no host security validation
HMAC verifiers sharing an issuer key can forge; not non-repudiation or defense against compromised same-principal/admin code
Exact principal separation, key provisioning, framing limits and RFC test vectors must be accepted before implementation adoption
Integer nanosecond values should be canonical decimal strings on the wire; no hand-written approximate JCS

recommendations.recommendation: Dedicated owned supervisor process outside the engine, MCP request loop and client lifetime, armed before dispatch. Start cooperative-only; process termination and automatic kill-on-close disabled. Consider Job Objects only after separately scoped ownership/nesting/fallback validation.
recommendations.rationale: Avoid dependence on the blocked request path without implicitly obtaining broad process-kill authority.
alternatives: Installed managed service after explicit installation/security approval
Validated owned Job Object containment with separately authorized termination
limits: A separate process alone is not proof of independence or native interruption
Supervisor death/host failure can leave work running in cooperative-only profile; no fit readiness claimed
No helper/process/job/handle created and no current host job membership inspected

recommendations.recommendation: Stage immutable versioned sidecar sources/build manifest, not edits to the installed extension. A future approved registrar must bind a fresh owned worker via PID, creation time, boot/generation/command and retained minimal-rights handle; pin source/package/engine-file digests and fresh module observations.
recommendations.rationale: Existing default sessions or historical identity receipts are not an authoritative new execution binding.
alternatives: Vendor-supported bound-control extension once it meets the same acceptance contract
Attach-to-existing-worker only with independently verified ownership, otherwise reject
limits: Disk/build hashes are not resident-bytecode attestation
No runtime version, loaded module, worker or installed extension inspected/changed here
Dependency/API availability and exact registration change surface require isolated review

recommendations.recommendation: Use integer monotonic nanoseconds with explicit host/boot/clock-domain binding; use UTC only for audit. Carry one absolute execution ceiling and cleanup min(total ceiling,stop+allowance); reject incomparable domains. Leave real budgets unset until bounded calibration and explicit scope approval.
recommendations.rationale: The documentation supports clock primitives, not evidence for a safe number of production seconds on this host.
alternatives: Conservative bounded cross-domain translation only after demonstrated delay bounds
limits: Symbolic100/110/113 fixtures are not measured host budgets
No sleep, timing probe or engine execution performed
Operating-system scheduling is not a hard real-time guarantee; unknown clock/budget blocks dispatch

recommendations.recommendation: Project owner accepts development scope, runtime operator accepts build/targets/budgets, independent assessor reviews acceptance and institutional steward accepts disclosure/retention. Record exact named principals later; separate artificial, disposable, empty-engine, service-change and termination grants; no fit/data/release inheritance.
recommendations.rationale: Acceptance evidence and software capability do not supply authority. Observation rights are not termination rights.
alternatives: Equivalent documented institutional roles if the organization uses different titles
Same person in multiple roles only with explicit institutional acceptance of the conflict and independent assessment
limits: Roles are proposed, not verified people or approvals
All24real project responses and28operational acceptance results remain untouched/pending
This checkpoint does not install an approval engine or authenticate a future human response

recommendations.recommendation: Place active journal/secrets outside Git and all synchronization/network folders; archive coherent sealed snapshots to an institution-approved restricted location only after access/retention review. Use metadata allowlists and opaque references, no participant/output/credential payloads. Preserve every existing packet; no deletion authorized.
recommendations.rationale: Separate active transactional state, recoverable restricted evidence and public summaries; archive copies are not active journals or automatic rollback authority.
alternatives: Organization-managed restricted document/object store with equivalent access and recovery controls
Previously restricted Dropbox project archive only after renewed steward/path/access approval; never active live SQLite there
limits: No folder/ACL/retention/access/backup configuration inspected or changed
No legal retention duration invented; retention_years and real paths remain null
User-scoped DPAPI is not portable institutional archive encryption or an escrow plan
